kibele.title: Kibele - AI Creative Partner & Ecosystem
kibele.excerpt: AI-powered creative ecosystem that eliminates blank-page fear. Inspiration rooms, AI partner, and real-time collaboration — all in one place.
kibele.intro: Kibele is a digital ecosystem designed to organize the chaos of early-stage creative thinking and elevate the creative process — not just a tool, but an intelligent partner that triggers your creativity and supports you from first spark to execution.

features.title: Inspiration Rooms
features.description: Collaborative digital workspaces customized for each project or interest area, keeping context always close at hand

features.title: Kibele AI Partner
features.description: An intelligent assistant that converses like a trusted friend, provides encouragement, and generates creative ideas on demand

features.title: Visual Memory Bank
features.description: Integrated research system with instant access to global artworks and design examples — no more tab-hopping

features.title: Shared Sketchpad
features.description: Interactive canvas for simultaneous drawing, note-taking, and mind-mapping with teammates in real-time

features.title: Idea Archive
features.description: Personal library that organizes all developed ideas and conversations in a structured, searchable format

benefits.title: Zero Blank-Page Fear
benefits.description: AI partner sparks the first idea the moment you need it — no more staring at an empty canvas

benefits.title: Real-Time Team Sync
benefits.description: Everyone stays aligned on the same visual plane, eliminating endless alignment meetings

benefits.title: Hours Saved Weekly
benefits.description: Stop switching between Pinterest, Behance, and browser tabs — everything lives in one place

benefits.title: Motivation on Demand
benefits.description: Supportive AI language keeps you in flow and reduces creative stress

beforeAfter.after: AI partner sparks ideas the moment you open the app

beforeAfter.before: Inspiration scattered across Pinterest, Behance, and browser tabs
beforeAfter.after: All references organized in one Visual Memory Bank

beforeAfter.before: Team alignment takes hours of back-and-forth messages
beforeAfter.after: Everyone synced on a shared canvas in real-time

beforeAfter.before: Ideas lost in chats, sticky notes, and random files
beforeAfter.after: Everything archived and instantly searchable in Idea Archive

items.desc: Creative individuals need a dedicated sounding board to develop ideas — Kibele fills that role autonomously

items.title: Scattered Inspiration
items.desc: Visual references, sketches, and AI support unified under one roof to dramatically speed up the creative workflow

items.title: Community-Driven
items.desc: Opens ideas to sharing, fostering a culture of collective and collaborative creativity

busracrafts.title: BusraCrafts - Digital Recipe Book for Knitters
busracrafts.excerpt: Digital companion for knitters to collect, organize, and share handcraft recipes. Your entire stitch library — always in your pocket, always searchable.
busracrafts.intro: BusraCrafts is a digital recipe journal that brings all your knitting and handcraft recipes together in one place — making them easy to organize, find, and share. Stitch by stitch, digitally yours.

features.title: Personal Library
features.description: Add, edit, and delete recipes; organize with smart categories; enrich entries with step-by-step photos

features.title: Discover Feed
features.description: Browse community-shared recipes, apply filters, like and comment, and save favorites to personal collections

features.title: Lists & Progress Tracking
features.description: Group recipes into custom lists such as 'This Week's Projects' and track completion status

features.title: Smart Search
features.description: Full-text search across your entire recipe library in milliseconds

features.title: Accounts & Roles
features.description: Members can publish recipes; visitors can freely browse without creating an account

features.title: One-Touch Sharing
features.description: Export any recipe as an elegant visual card to share via message or social media

features.title: PWA Experience
features.description: Opens in the browser and installs to home screen for a full native-app feel

benefits.title: Never Lose a Recipe Again
benefits.description: Every pattern centralized, searchable, and accessible anytime — even offline

benefits.title: Crystal-Clear Instructions
benefits.description: Structured photo-guided steps eliminate confusion and missing details

benefits.title: Instant Sharing
benefits.description: Share any recipe as a beautiful card or direct link in one tap

benefits.title: Community Discovery
benefits.description: Find new patterns and techniques through a curated community feed

benefits.title: Always With You
benefits.description: Mobile-first PWA works on any device with no app store download required

panela.title: Panela - E-Commerce Management & Research Platform
panela.excerpt: AI-powered product discovery, ad analysis, and automated research platform for e-commerce entrepreneurs. A modern solution replacing Excel.
panela.intro: Panela is an AI-powered business management and research platform designed for e-commerce entrepreneurs. The system automates e-commerce processes from product discovery to marketing strategies, enhanced with artificial intelligence.

features.title: Smart Ad Analysis Assistant
features.description: Analyzes your ad copy using Google's Gemini AI model, optimizes your target audience, and provides marketing strategies

features.title: Automatic Quiz Generator
features.description: Automatically generates quiz questions from your educational content — fill-in-the-blank, matching, multiple choice

features.title: Automatic Meta Ad Scanner
features.description: Automatically finds companies running active ads on Facebook and Instagram, and adds products to your database

features.title: Smart Product Scoring System
features.description: Automatically scores products from 0–100 based on problem-solving, profit margin, trend analysis, and social media engagement

features.title: Automatic Data Organization
features.description: Automatically migrates old-format links in your database to the new format

benefits.title: Time Savings
benefits.description: Automated systems replace manual research, saving hours every week

benefits.title: AI-Powered Strategies
benefits.description: Leverage artificial intelligence for smarter marketing and product decisions

benefits.title: Secure Data Storage
benefits.description: Enterprise-grade security with Supabase backend

benefits.title: Unified Platform
benefits.description: Manage hundreds of products and ads from a single dashboard

Built for Getir Dealers — this enterprise solution powers Getir's dealer network, enabling seamless barcode management and product information access.

features.title: Enterprise Dealer Management

courier-shift-planner.title: Courier Shift Planning System
courier-shift-planner.excerpt: Intelligent shift planning system for courier companies. Visual weekly scheduling with automatic hour calculations and Excel reporting.
courier-shift-planner.intro: An intelligent web application designed for courier companies and businesses to simplify weekly shift planning. Manage your couriers' working hours, days off, and shift balances from a single screen.

features.title: Visual Weekly Planning
features.description: 7-day weekly view to see all shifts at a glance with drag-and-drop reordering

features.title: Smart Time Management
features.description: Edit shift times with a single click, quick adjustment buttons, and easy day-off marking

features.title: Automatic Calculations
features.description: Real-time calculation of total working hours with color-coded status indicators

features.title: Flexible Courier Management
features.description: Add, edit, hide, or delete couriers with emoji avatar support

features.title: Day Hiding Feature
features.description: Simplify your view by hiding unnecessary days and restoring them instantly

features.title: Data Export
features.description: Save plans in JSON format and generate Excel reports with a single click

features.title: Real-Time Updates
features.description: Automatic recalculation when hours change, no manual work required

features.title: Default Settings
features.description: Configure default hours and times for new couriers automatically

benefits.title: Time Savings
benefits.description: Replace hours of manual Excel planning with minutes of visual editing

benefits.title: Error Prevention
benefits.description: Automatic validation prevents scheduling mistakes and missing coverage

benefits.title: Fair Distribution
benefits.description: Ensure balanced work hours across all team members automatically

benefits.title: Professional Reports
benefits.description: Generate Excel reports ready for accounting and management review

benefits.title: User-Friendly Interface
benefits.description: Intuitive design requires no training, works on all devices

benefits.title: Data Security
benefits.description: Safe JSON save/load system prevents data loss and enables easy backup
